title: Engagement tool-call policy (<engagement>/policy.yaml)
description: Shape accepted by bb_stack.policy.ToolPolicy.from_mapping. Every key is optional; an absent file means the shipped default posture.

mode.description: Phase-2 short-circuit. bypass allows everything, read-only denies every non-read-only tool, default falls through.

read_only.description: Extra read-only tool patterns; the shipped defaults are kept and these are appended.

deny.description: Evaluated first; first match wins and no mode or allow rule can override it.

allow.description: Evaluated after deny; first match wins.

rule.description: A tool-name string, or a mapping with an optional tool/when/message/updated_input.

tool.description: Tool-name pattern; defaults to '*' when omitted.

updated_input.description: Argument rewrite applied when the rule matches; a null value deletes the key.

when.description: Argument conditions; all present conditions are ANDed.

arg_contains.description: argument name -> substring: substring is in str(arguments[name])

arg_in.description: argument name -> list: arguments[name] is a member of the list

arg_present.description: argument names that must be present with a non-empty value
